items.source: Note that use of this package does not require the use of the ajc compiler or AspectJ load-time weaver. It is intended to enable the use of a valuable subset of AspectJ functionality, with consistent semantics, with the proxy-based Spring AOP framework.
items.translation: 请注意，使用此包并不需要用到 `ajc` 编译器或 AspectJ 加载时织入器。其目的是启用一个有价值的 AspectJ 功能子集，使其与基于代理的 Spring AOP 框架具有一致的语义。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that creates a new instance of the specified aspect class for every SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现 `AspectInstanceFactory`，为每次调用 `SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance()` 创建指定 Aspect 类的新实例。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that is backed by a specified singleton object, returning the same instance for every SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现由指定单例对象支持的 AspectInstanceFactory，每次调用 SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() 时返回相同的实例。

items.source: An implementation of the AspectJ ProceedingJoinPoint interface wrapping an AOP Alliance MethodInvocation.
items.translation: AspectJ `ProceedingJoinPoint` 接口的一个实现，它封装了一个 AOP Alliance `MethodInvocation`。

items.source: ParameterNameDiscoverer implementation that tries to deduce parameter names for an advice method from the pointcut expression, returning, and throwing clauses.
items.translation: 实现ParameterNameDiscoverer接口，尝试从切面表达式（pointcut expression）的返回和抛出子句中推断建议方法的参数名称。

items.source: Spring AOP ClassFilter implementation using AspectJ type matching.
items.translation: 使用 AspectJ 类型匹配的 Spring AOP `ClassFilter` 实现。

items.source: AspectJPointcutAdvisor adapts an AbstractAspectJAdvice to the PointcutAdvisor interface.
items.translation: AspectJPointcutAdvisor 适配一个 AbstractAspectJAdvice 到 PointcutAdvisor 接口。

items.source: Base class for AOP Alliance Advice classes wrapping an AspectJ aspect or an AspectJ-annotated advice method.
items.translation: AOP 联盟 Advice 类的基类，用于包装 AspectJ 切面或带有 AspectJ 注解的 advice 方法。

items.source: Spring Pointcut implementation that uses the AspectJ weaver to evaluate a pointcut expression.
items.translation: 使用 AspectJ 织器来评估点切面表达式的 Spring Pointcut 实现。

items.source: Implementation of AspectJ's IMessageHandler interface that routes AspectJ weaving messages through the same logging system as the regular Spring messages.
items.translation: 实现 AspectJ 的 `IMessageHandler` 接口，将 AspectJ 织入消息通过与普通 Spring 消息相同的日志系统进行路由。

items.source: Core Spring AOP interfaces, built on AOP Alliance AOP interoperability interfaces.
items.translation: 核心 Spring AOP 接口，基于 AOP Alliance AOP 互操作性接口构建。

items.source: Classes enabling AspectJ 5 @Annotated classes to be used in Spring AOP.
items.translation: 使 AspectJ 5 @Annotated 类能够在 Spring AOP 中使用的类。

items.source: Base classes enabling auto-proxying based on AspectJ.
items.translation: 基于 AspectJ 实现自动代理的基础类。

items.source: Interface implemented to provide an instance of an AspectJ aspect.
items.translation: 用于提供 AspectJ 切面实例的接口。

items.source:
Thrown in response to an ambiguous binding being detected when
trying to resolve a method's parameter names.
items.translation: 在尝试解析方法参数名称时检测到歧义绑定而抛出的异常。

items.source: Spring AOP advice wrapping an AspectJ after advice method.
items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装 AspectJ 后置建议方法。

items.source: Spring AOP advice wrapping an AspectJ after-returning advice method.
items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装 AspectJ 返回后建议方法。

items.source: Spring AOP advice wrapping an AspectJ after-throwing advice method.
items.translation: Spring AOP 建议包装了 AspectJ 的 after-throwing 切面方法。

items.source: Utility methods for dealing with AspectJ advisors.
items.translation: 用于处理 AspectJ 顾问的实用方法。

items.source:
Spring AOP around advice (MethodInterceptor) that wraps
an AspectJ advice method.
items.translation: 环绕通知（MethodInterceptor）包装了 AspectJ 通知方法。

items.source: Spring AOP Advisor that can be used for any AspectJ pointcut expression.
items.translation: 可用于任何 AspectJ 点切面表达式的 Spring AOP Advisor。

items.source: Spring AOP advice that wraps an AspectJ before method.
items.translation: 环绕 AspectJ 前置通知的 Spring AOP 建议。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by types that can supply the information
needed to sort advice/advisors by AspectJ's precedence rules.
items.translation: 由能够按 AspectJ 优先级规则对建议/顾问进行排序的信息提供类型所实现的接口。

items.source: Utility methods for working with AspectJ proxies.
items.translation: 用于处理 AspectJ 代理的工具方法。

items.source: Introduction advisor delegating to the given object.
items.translation: 介绍顾问委派给给定对象。

items.source:
Interface to be implemented by Spring AOP Advisors wrapping AspectJ
aspects that may have a lazy initialization strategy.
items.translation: 由 Spring AOP Advisor 实现的接口，用于包装可能具有懒初始化策略的 AspectJ 切面。
